5.desc: Inflicting Fusion Burst or Tune Rupture - Shifting increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by {0} and grants {1} Fusion DMG Bonus for {2}s.

When the Resonator inflicts Fusion Burst on the enemies, they gain the following effects: Gain {0} Fusion DMG Bonus for {1} s. While this effect is active, casting an Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator {2} Fusion DMG Bonus for {3}s.

Inflicting Glacio Chafe on enemies increases Glacio DMG dealt by {0} for {1}s. The Resonator gains the Snowfall effect for {11}s, which can be triggered once every {2}s. While Snowfall is active:
- Dealing Resonance Liberation DMG removes Snowfall and increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by {4} for {5}s. While the effect is active, dealing Resonance Liberation DMG extends its duration by {8}s, triggered once every {9}s, up to {10} times.
- Casting Outro Skill removes Snowfall and grants {6} Glacio DMG Bonus to the incoming Resonator for {7}s.
When Snowfall is removed, only one of the effects above can be triggered.
